---
title: Choose a model
description: Pick a model in Run configuration. Changing it does not start a turn.
sidebar:
  order: 5
---

The model selector is in **Run configuration** in the editor top bar (and next to **Run mode** on `/projects/new`).

Changing the model does not start a turn. The next message you send uses the selected model.

If a model is unavailable, the selector shows it as disabled. Pick another model.
